threads.body: The `otel/weaver` container is referenced by a mutable tag without a digest pin, which reduces build reproducibility and increases supply-chain risk (a tag can be republished). Consider pinning this image to a specific sha256 digest (as is already done for most other container references in this PR) and keep the tag as an inline comment for readability.

Upstream notes indicate `actions/attest-build-provenance` is a wrapper around `actions/attest` and recommends new implementations use `actions/attest`. Optional: consider switching to `actions/attest` to reduce indirection and potential future deprecation churn, while keeping the workflow behavior equivalent.

threads.body: [General] Weaver 0.26 changed `registry live-check` to bind both the OTLP and admin listeners to `127.0.0.1` by default. Because this container exposes those ports and accesses them through Docker's mapped host ports, the listeners will no longer be reachable: the listening-port wait can time out, and metric forwarding plus `/stop` cannot connect. Explicitly bind the live-check listener to all container interfaces.
